summary: Rogers Corporation is NOT a distressed/lying name. The -29.5% drawdown reflects EV/HEV demand slowdown and topline contraction, but the underlying disclosure is clean: PwC Big 4 with effective ICFR, no going-concern, NET CASH balance sheet (-$101.7M net debt), DuPont $162.5M termination fee fully deployed to deleveraging, two directors buying $550K open-market at $148-150 (underwater at cutoff). Q1 2024 10-Q honestly disclosed accelerated -12.5% topline decline but margin recovery to +5.5% op income from prior-year loss. The one Mode B catch (C1, C6) — accelerating top-line deterioration and unfinished restructuring — is real but transparently disclosed. This is an honest cyclical drawdown, not a forensic short candidate.
